test_cases.query: How do I sort a slice in Go?
test_cases.response: You can sort a slice in Go using the sort.Slice function. For example: sort.Slice(mySlice, func(i, j int) bool { return mySlice[i] < mySlice[j] }). This sorts the slice in ascending order. You can also use sort.SliceStable for a stable sort that preserves the order of equal elements.
